description: This file is a unit test class for the RetrievePolicy class within the policies command package, testing JSON serialization, equality, immutability, and exception handling.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for the RetrievePolicy class, covering immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrievePolicy instances are immutable and their dependent classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for RetrievePolicy.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrievePolicy with null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrievePolicy with null string PolicyId throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating a RetrievePolicy with an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON output from RetrievePolicy.toJson matches the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a RetrievePolicy instance from valid JSON and verifies its fields.

methods.name: parseRetrievePolicyCommand
methods.description: Tests parsing a RetrievePolicy command from JSON using the GlobalCommandRegistry.
